subject: Re: PO & invoice readiness — action items and owner matrix
messages_1_subject: PO timing and invoice windows for Q2 bookings
messages_1_body:
Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Hope you're well. We are finalizing internal plans to ensure Q2 bookings are recognized on schedule. Procurement is close to issuing the PO but our accounting team needs visibility on the exact invoice window and any required PO fields to avoid holding revenue at month-end.

Can you confirm: 1) the earliest invoice date you need once the PO is received, 2) whether Redwood requires a signed SOW attached to the PO, and 3) any mandatory PO fields (billing address, tax info, legal entity)?

I attached our draft PO for reference and labeled the rows that will be populated by our procurement team. If possible, can we have a short owner matrix (who approves, who invoices, who confirms booking) by tomorrow?

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Reeves
Finance Lead, Acme Corp
acct@acme.com

Attachment: Acme_PO_Draft_March9.pdf (stub)
messages_2_subject: Re: PO timing and invoice windows for Q2 bookings
messages_2_body:
Dana — thanks for the clear note and the draft PO. High level answers first:

• Earliest invoice date: we can invoice as soon as we receive a valid PO and the signed order form/SOW is attached. For bookings recognition in March we need invoices to be posted no later than the month-close cutoff — for Redwood that's 3 business days before month end if the PO arrives in the final week.

• SOW: yes, please attach the signed SOW to the PO to avoid manual hold during revenue ops review.

• Mandatory PO fields: billing_entity, PO number, billing_address, tax_id (if applicable), invoice frequency, and contact for remittance. We can provide a PO template with example fields if helpful.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) Ben — can you confirm the hard invoice-post cutoff we should give Acme for March? (assign to @ben_carter)
2) Marissa — please confirm the commercial commit and whether any milestone dates shift the recognition window.
3) Dana — if procurement can confirm PO number + attach SOW, Redwood will queue invoice within 48 hours and notify Acme accounting.

I'll attach a simple owner matrix and checklist (first draft) in a follow-up.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Finance Partner, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

messages_3_subject: Re: PO timing and invoice windows for Q2 bookings
messages_3_body:
Soojin / Dana — quick update from commercial:

We intend to commit $225k for the Redwood Dedicated pilot with a April 1 start. There's no milestone-based hold beyond the PO/SOW; recognition should follow standard SaaS ARR rules once invoiced.

One note: the customer asked if we can split the first invoice (50%) on April 1 and the balance after 30 days. That would change the booking recognition dates. If finance prefers a single invoice to simplify, let me know and I'll request a single invoice from Acme.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

messages_4_subject: PO fields & invoice cutoff details (owner matrix attached)
messages_4_body:
Thanks team — I reviewed. Short answers and an uploaded checklist:

• Cutoff: for March recognition we need the invoice to be posted in our accounting system by 2027-03-28 23:59 PT to make month-end close. If a PO/SOW arrives after 3/25 we can still ticket for next month but we cannot guarantee March recognition.

• Split invoice: we can support split invoices (50/50) but booking recognition will follow the revenue schedule of the invoices posted. If Acme prefers all recognized in April we should take a single invoice dated 4/1.

• Required PO fields (minimal): PO number, legal entity name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), billing address, tax_id, invoice remit contact and email, SOW attachment reference.

I attached a one-page owner matrix (PO_Timing_Matrix_v2.xlsx) and a short checklist (billing-readiness-checklist.pdf). Please route the final PO to acct@redwood.com and cc me for visibility.

Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: PO_Timing_Matrix_v2.xlsx (stub)
